notes.title: Building Freedom Update
notes.notes:
In this groundbreaking update, grid system constraints can be removed. Say goodbye to those perfectly aligned squares and rectangles! Now, you can unleash your architectural creativity without being confined by the invisible lattice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922349/54d6cae5aae12ece6f2ea87e519b35dd9d2f6a67.gif[/img]
